title: Text Segment V2.5
description: A segment of a Text, made of Text Words, with the time it spans and the confidence with which it was recognised.

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Text Segment is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Text Segment is or is intended to be located.

TextSegmentID.description: Unique identifier of this Text Segment instance.

TextSegmentTime.description: Time this Text Segment was produced.

TextQualifier.description: Qualifier providing information on Sub-Types, Formats and Attributes of the Text.

ConfidenceScore.description: Confidence with which the segment was recognised, 0 to 1.

Segment.description: The Text Words of the segment, in order.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal and security information on the Data.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Text Segment (plain text, max 2048 characters).
